affected_region: Abdomen and Pelvis - Peritoneum, Mesentery, Omentum, Retroperitoneum, Pelvic Mesentery (including lower pelvis surrounding rectum and bladder); Chest - Bilateral Lungs; Upper Pelvis/Bony Pelvis
abnormal_visual_patterns_summary: Extensive irregular hypodense nodules and masses scattered throughout peritoneum, omentum, mesentery, retroperitoneum, pelvic mesentery (pre-contrast liver slices 32-44, 5mm_CAP slices 035-084+, COR_3mm_AVG slices 08-97 extensive bilateral lesions, innumerable small nodules/masses invading bowel loops, kidneys, rectum, bladder base); omental caking/thickening; bowel wall thickening/displacement; serosal implants/mesenteric nodules; bilateral pulmonary nodules/masses (5mm_LUNG slices 001-034+, COR_CHEST_MIPS slices 16-56+ innumerable projected irregular/heterogeneous/small hyperdense nodules throughout lung fields); innumerable small pelvic nodules (COR_3mm_AVG 60-97 persistent pelvic mesenteric nodules/clusters around rectum/bladder); symmetric kidneys, normal liver pre-contrast, normal bony pelvis/spine/psoas
reasoning: COR_3mm_AVG slices 60-97 reconfirm extensive pelvic mesenteric nodules/masses with irregular hypodense lesions invading rectum/bladder base; pattern of peritoneal carcinomatosis and prior pulmonary metastases persists without new bone/liver involvement; highly consistent with advanced metastatic colorectal cancer.
recommendation: Biopsy recommended; Consult oncologist; Consider PET-CT for staging
